fusions.name: Billow
fusions.desc: Snaps your mantle out from behind the shield across an arc 2.5 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Colours to the Fore
fusions.desc: Hurls your woven standard to stand in the target, dealing 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mirror Weave
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Stitch in Time
fusions.desc: When a condition on you wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
